parameters.name: MatchExpressions
parameters.description: The tag match conditions that are described in a JSON string. For more information about this parameter, see the **Additional description of the MatchExpressions parameter** section.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the alert rule.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the alert rule is enabled. Valid values:

- 1: enables the alert rule.
- 0: disables the alert rule.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the alert rule.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-prometheus-alert-rules --name Prometheus_Alert --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c0bad479465464e1d8c1e641b0afb0000 --type '自定义' --status 1 --match-expressions key_:_severity_,_value_:_critical_,_operator_:_re --tags Value=zhangsan Key=owner --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListPrometheusAlertRules --region cn-hangzhou --Status 1 --Type '自定义' --Tags.1.Value zhangsan --ClusterId c0bad479465464e1d8c1e641b0afb0000 --Tags.1.Key owner --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name Prometheus_Alert --MatchExpressions 'key_:_severity_,_value_:_critical_,_operator_:_re'
